Despite mixed analyst ratings, with an average "Hold" and a consensus price target of $139.40, Applied Optoelectronics exceeded quarterly expectations with $0.06 EPS and $191.92 million in revenue, an 86.3% year-over-year increase. However, the company remains unprofitable, and insiders have sold approximately $44.2 million worth of stock in the last 90 days.

events.title: Berenberg initiates HawkEye 360 stock with buy on defense demand
events.summary: Berenberg has initiated coverage on HawkEye 360 Inc. (NYSE:HAWK) with a Buy rating and a price target of $24.00, citing strong demand in defense and the company's unique position in commercial radio-frequency signals intelligence. Despite a recent stock decline, Berenberg highlights HawkEye 360's significant organic growth, high gross margins, and expanding EBITDA margins, driven by increased government spending on electronic warfare. The company also reported an 87% revenue increase in Q2 2026, though it faced a wider net loss due to public market transition costs.

events.title: Insider Selling: First Solar (NASDAQ:FSLR) CTO Sells $160,000.00 in Stock
events.summary: First Solar (NASDAQ:FSLR) CTO Markus Gloeckler sold 800 shares of the company's stock for $160,000.00 at an average price of $200.00, reducing his direct holdings by 12.04% to 5,842 shares. This transaction was part of a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The company's shares traded down 0.2% and are near the lower end of their 52-week range, despite recently exceeding quarterly earnings expectations.

events.title: Prediction: Intel Stock Could Have a Major Catalyst Ahead
events.summary: Intel's stock has seen a dramatic reversal, with a 267.6% increase over the past year due to its 18A ramp, NVIDIA investment, and AI-driven data center growth. 24/7 Wall St. has a buy recommendation and a $101.53 price target for Intel, citing strong Q2 2026 results where revenue grew 25.42% and data center/AI revenue jumped 59%. The company faces challenges like foundry operating losses and mixed analyst sentiment, but its turnaround potential and lower relative multiple compared to NVIDIA and AMD make its future outlook promising.

events.title: Legal & General Group Plc Makes New $8.10 Million Investment in Axsome Therapeutics, Inc. $AXSM
events.summary: Legal & General Group Plc has made a new $8.10 million investment in Axsome Therapeutics, Inc. by purchasing 33,072 shares. This comes as Axsome Therapeutics reported a quarterly loss and missed revenue estimates, yet analyst sentiment remains positive with a "Moderate Buy" rating. Insider transactions show recent sales by company directors to cover tax obligations.

events.title: Insider Buying: RGC Resources (NASDAQ:RGCO) Director Acquires 1,000 Shares
events.summary: RGC Resources (NASDAQ:RGCO) Director John Williamson III recently acquired 1,000 shares of the company's stock at $21.30 each, increasing his holdings by 0.56%. This insider transaction comes as the company reported quarterly earnings and revenue below analyst expectations, though it maintains a 4.0% dividend yield and an overall "Buy" rating from analysts. Institutional investors have also been adjusting their positions in RGCO.

events.title: Investors Purchase High Volume of Call Options on Cheniere Energy (NYSE:LNG)
events.summary: Investors showed unusually high interest in call options for Cheniere Energy (NYSE:LNG), with trading volume significantly exceeding typical levels. This comes as institutional ownership remains strong and the company's stock trades near its 12-month high, despite slightly missing recent quarterly earnings estimates. Analysts generally maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for LNG, with a consensus price target slightly above its current trading price.

events.title: Can AMD's Saudi AI Buildout Challenge NVIDIA and Broadcom?
events.summary: AMD, Cisco, and HUMAIN are expanding their AI infrastructure collaboration in Saudi Arabia, with plans to deploy up to 1 gigawatt of AI infrastructure by 2030, using AMD Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs. This initiative aims to strengthen AMD's competitive position against NVIDIA and Broadcom in the data center AI market, focusing on sovereign AI capacity. Despite AMD's growth in this sector, it faces significant challenges from NVIDIA's established ecosystem and Broadcom's custom AI accelerators and networking leadership.

events.title: BUUU Group to Acquire 60% of Brightray, Raise Over $60 Million
events.summary: BUUU Group Limited is set to acquire a 60% stake in Brightray Science Inc., marking a strategic shift towards modular AI data center delivery. This acquisition is coupled with private placements aiming to raise over $60 million to support Brightray's expansion, including a project pipeline targeting 2GW of capacity across various regions. BUUU plans to relocate its headquarters to Singapore, aligning with Brightray's Southeast Asian operations and international growth.

events.title: Insider Selling: Leidos (NYSE:LDOS) Director Sells 1,000 Shares
events.summary: Leidos director Gary Stephen May sold 1,000 shares of LDOS stock for $140.85 per share, totaling $140,850, reducing his ownership by 8.93%. Despite this insider selling, Leidos reported strong quarterly earnings and revenue, exceeding analyst expectations, and announced a new share buyback program and quarterly dividend. Analysts currently maintain a "Hold" rating for the stock with an average price target of $162.93.

events.title: How Equinix has found a niche in the multitrillion-dollar AI data center boom
events.summary: Equinix, a legacy data center company, has strategically positioned itself to benefit from the AI boom by partnering with Nvidia and Together AI, allowing customers flexible ways to run AI models. Despite being a colocation facility rather than a hyperscaler, Equinix's stock is up 33% this year, raising its market cap to $100 billion. The company's focus on inference and urban data center locations gives it a unique advantage in the evolving AI landscape, even as some investors remain skeptical about its growth potential.

events.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (HPE) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
events.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) reported record Q3 2026 financial results, exceeding all commitments with significant growth in revenue, gross margin, operating profit, and EPS, driven by strong demand for AI and networking solutions. The company raised its fiscal 2026 and 2027 outlooks, with orders growing faster than revenue, resulting in a record backlog despite ongoing supply constraints. HPE also highlighted an expanded collaboration with Oracle for gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure and the successful integration of Juniper Networks.
